notes.Model options: '6.7b', '2.7b', '1.3b', '350m' for OPT, and '7B', '13B', '30B', and '65B' for LLaMA
notes.true_false: true if you want to add '_true_false' as suffix to dataset names for training
notes.paper_layers: SAPLMA paper tests layers: last(32), 28th, 24th, 20th, middle/16th. Negative indices account for embedding layer at index 0: -1=32, -5=28, -9=24, -13=20, -17=16
notes.paper_repeat: SAPLMA paper uses 3 random restarts per training run
